pairs.difference: A places the whistle against a broadly pale background. B adds a concentrated pale halo behind the whistle and darker corners, making separation depend more on that glow.
pairs.fix: Keep the yellow background more evenly light, with a gentler bright area behind the whistle.

pairs.difference: Both use middle-value brass against a light turquoise background, dark red cord accents below, and narrow bright highlights around the bell. Neither clearly departs from the real cards' value grouping.

A has a brighter red field and broad light groups across the cup and saucer. B surrounds its pale cup with a much darker burgundy field and a concentrated black shadow beneath the saucer, increasing isolation.
pairs.fix: Brighten the burgundy background toward red-orange and soften the dark shadow beneath the saucer. Keep a broad light area across the cup and saucer.

pairs.difference: Both group the apples into dark masses, the basket into middle values, and the cloth and tabletop into light shapes. Their background gradients differ, but neither gives a decisive value-only finding.

A has a broad dark left side and a light right side across the barrel. B spreads smaller light accents across the hoops while keeping the wood mostly middle-value. Both arrangements fit the real cards' contrast range.

A keeps the windows relatively pale and concentrates darkness beneath the car and inside the grille. B darkens the windows and adds strong alternating light and dark patches across the bumper, grille, and wheel rims.
pairs.fix: Lighten the windows and simplify the bumper and wheel rims into broad silver shapes with fewer bright-white and dark patches. Keep the deepest shadow beneath the car.

pairs.difference: A gives the tent broad, readable middle and light faces against darker trees. B distributes light and dark patches throughout the foliage, grass, tent, and foreground, weakening the tent's value separation.
pairs.fix: Group the forest and grass into quieter, darker shapes. Give the yellow tent broad light faces, and reduce scattered bright accents around the clearing.

pairs.difference: A groups the forest into a dark backdrop and the pot into a broad middle-dark bowl with a light rim. B breaks the soup, pot, supports, stones, and surrounding ground into many competing light and dark patches.
pairs.fix: Keep the forest broadly dark and simplify the pot into one dark rounded mass with a light rim. Reduce bright patches on the soup, wooden supports, stones, and ground so the fire remains the main light accent.

pattern: Generated cards tend to scatter bright accents across secondary details or isolate the hero with a concentrated background glow. The real cards more often preserve broad, quiet value groups.
